snippet.title: PNEUMA Official Teaser Trailer - Co-Op Sci-fi Horror Ghost Hunting Game
snippet.description:
🚨 DEMO COMING THIS OCTOBER STEAM SCREAM FESTIVAL!🚨
PNEUMA is a 1–4 player co-op sci-fi horror ghost hunting game.
Wishlist on Steam -Link in our Bio

WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4171930/PNEUMA/

~The ghost can possess you and make you turn on your team

~Cast rituals and commune with the ghost using your voice and microphone

~Innovative new paranormal investigation tools with a sci-fi twist

~17+ lore-driven ghosts with unique behaviour and abilities

~Dynamic and personalised scares and ghost events

Tag your team and Sign up for the Beta!
 #coophorror   #indiehorrorgame   #indiegame
